properties.statement: A VERIFICATION HAS NOWHERE TO PUT THE CAVEATS THAT QUALIFY ITS RESULT, SO dev_storyflow HAS RATIFIED 'CARRY THE GRADING AND ALL BOUNDS IN THE NODE NAME' AS FLEET DOCTRINE — AND THE DAMAGE IS VISIBLE IN REFLOW2'S OWN OUTPUT, NOT ONLY THEIRS. Reported 2026-08-08 by dragon Boss f96eccd3 and independently by w-02baf79f. A Verification carries name, status, kind, method, level, last_run_at and NO field for the qualifications on the result. Because a bare `passing` reads to a session six weeks out as uniform coverage, the fleet arrived independently at the workaround and then adopted it on the bus as practice. THREE MEASURED CONSEQUENCES. (1) graph_report.top_gaps[0].title is a ~2,000-CHARACTER ESSAY, because a gap title embeds the verification's name; loop_status.verifications.attention[] is unreadable for the same reason; w-02baf79f measured one `name` at ~450 WORDS carrying a full graded walk report — verdict, L0/L2/L3 legs, a correction with six measured field counts, refuted mechanisms, file:line citations, bounds and an evidence path. Their judgement, which is the fair one: THAT IS EXCELLENT CONTENT IN THE WRONG FIELD. `name` is what a list renders. (2) THE NAMES ARE NO LONGER USABLE AS NAMES — they cannot be scanned, sorted or shown in a list. (3) THE BOUNDS ARE PROSE INSIDE A STRING, SO NOTHING CAN ACT ON THEM: `ver:fleet_compaction_hook` carries `status: passing` while its own name argues at length that it is FAILING, and no detector can see the contradiction because one half is a field and the other half is an essay. THIS IS NOT ONLY THEIR PROBLEM. reflow2's own loop_status verification digest reads the same way for the same reason — see ver:a-session-cannot-name-another-design, whose `name` is a multi-paragraph rationale — so this design has been paying the cost of the missing field without diagnosing it. THE SECOND-ORDER COST w-02baf79f NAMES: loop_status is advertised as the one cheap call and every worker is told to make it routinely, and it now returns a payload dominated by prose nobody asked for, which is a direct disincentive to the habit the loop depends on. FIX SHAPE, theirs: a first-class `bounds`/`caveats` field and ideally a `grade`, so `name` can go back to being a name and the qualifications become data the loop can reason about; plus a `findings`/`report` field so a walk's evidence has somewhere to live that is not its title; and truncate `name` in loop_status's rollup, or return `name` + `detail` separately. WEIGH WITH fact:defect-verification-evidence-is-prose-so-passing-can-contradict-itself — that report asks for structured RESULT fields (exit_code, command, observed/expected) for the same underlying reason, and the two proposals should be settled together rather than one at a time.
